methods.label: Double the median
methods.explanation: Extend \(AD\) to \(E\) so that \(DE=AD\), and join \(CE\). Then \(\triangle ABD\cong\triangle ECD\) (SAS), so \(CE=AB\). In \(\triangle ACE\), \(AC+CE>AE=2AD\), giving \(AB+AC>2AD\).
